answer_1.quote: We formulate two novel tasks... The second task is edit generation, in which a model generates edits directly from a given reviewer comment and paper text.
answer_1.outputs: paragraph-level edits (additions, deletions, or modifications) addressing reviewer comments

answer_4.quote: We generate edits with GPT-4... We explore the differences between GPT-written and author-written edits more deeply with an analysis by two expert judges (authors of this paper, with multiple CS/ML publications) on 85 comments.
answer_4.guideline: Experts rated each edit on compliance, promises, paraphrases, technical details, and overall comprehensiveness in addressing the reviewer comment.
